capabilities: Create a WeChat Official Account draft from the current Markdown note
Convert Markdown to the inline HTML the WeChat editor accepts
Upload body and cover images, re-hosting remote ones and cropping covers to 900×500
Prompt for missing title, digest, author and cover, then write answers back to frontmatter
Publish article bundles as folders, including translation selection via index.md
disambiguation: Despite the name, it never publishes an article; it only creates a draft in the WeChat draft box for manual publishing.
extras: Desktop only, with runtime messages in Chinese. Credentials deliberately live outside the vault so they never reach synced storage; the plugin reads only that one file and writes nothing outside the vault. Publishing aborts rather than shipping a draft with un-replaced image references, and failed drafts release the cover's permanent-material slot.
problem: WeChat's editor accepts only inline HTML and its own image URLs, so pasting a Markdown note in loses formatting and pictures; Obsidian has no way to push notes to a WeChat draft box.

relations.evidence: Turn the Markdown note you are editing into a WeChat Official Account draft

requires.name: WeChat Official Account with material and draft API permission
AppSecret stored in a file outside the vault, with IP whitelisted

summary: WeChat Official Account publisher that turns the current Markdown note into a WeChat draft with inline HTML and re-hosted images.
